newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech group near majority in Bohemia Sekt.
newsitem.headline: Czech group near majority in Bohemia Sekt.

text.p: Czech insurer Ceska Pojistovna a.s. investment unit KIS said on Thursday that the Pojistovna group was close to owning a majority share in Czech champagne maker Bohemia Sekt a.s.
Petr Havlicek, portfolio manager at KIS, told Reuters that the Pojistovna group controlled 49.3 percent of Bohemia Sekt.
Under new stock exchange rules the company is obliged to offer to buy shares from other shareholders if it goes over 50 percent. Havlicek would not say what KIS's next move would be.
"We found ourselves in front of a sensitive barrier and from that time we have not strengthened our position," said Havlicek.
Bohemia Sekt is the only Czech sparkling wine producer. In the first six months of 1996 it posted a 45 million crown gross profit compared with 43 million in the same period in 1995.
On Thursday Bohemia Sekt was up four crowns to 3,439 on the parallel market of the Prague Stock Exchange.
